div.div: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ , in the Kur [xviii. 5], (S,) means (tropical:) And may-be thou wilt hill thyself (S, K) with grief, (S,) being beyond measure eager for their becoming Muslims. (K, TA.) These words imply an incitement to abstain from regret. (B.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
